title: Weighted degree norms bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $0<\delta\leq 1$, and let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. The sum of the degree-part norms weighted by $(1-\delta)^k$ satisfies $\sum_{k=0}^{n}(1-\delta)^k\|f^{=k}\|_2\leq\delta^{-1}\|f\|_2$, with norms taken under uniform measure on the cube.
